Privacy policy

What information we collect, why, and what we do with it. Last updated 7 November 2026.

The short version

This website doesn't have accounts and doesn't store your details on our servers. When you fill a form or contact a seller, the website opens WhatsApp with your message ready, and nothing is sent until you press send.

1. Information you give us

When you message us on WhatsApp, call, or email, we receive what you choose to share, such as:

  • your name, business name, phone number and location
  • product details, prices, photos and videos you send for advertising
  • what you're looking for, if you use Find it for me
  • payment screenshots when you pay for a package

2. How we use it

  • to reply to you and provide our advertising service
  • to create and publish ads for your products (seller details shown in ads, such as your business name, location and WhatsApp number, are public)
  • to connect buyers with sellers when you ask us to find something
  • to confirm payments and keep basic business records
  • to check that sellers are genuine and to investigate reports of fraud

We don't sell your personal information.

3. Who else is involved

  • WhatsApp and Meta carry the messages you send us and run the Facebook and Instagram ads we create. Their own privacy policies apply.
  • GitHub hosts this website and may keep basic technical logs such as your IP address.
  • Google Fonts provides the fonts on this site, so your browser connects to Google when a page loads.
  • Sellers receive your messages and phone number when you contact them.

4. Stored on your own phone

The site remembers your saved products, your area and your language choice in your own browser. This stays on your device, we can't see it, and you can clear it any time by clearing your browser data.

5. How long we keep information

We keep chats, ad materials and payment records only as long as we need them to serve you and for our business records. Ask us and we'll delete your information unless we need to keep it by law.

6. Your rights

Under Ghana's Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843), you can ask to see the personal information we hold about you, to correct it, or to have it deleted, and you can object to us using it for marketing. Contact us using the details below.

7. Contact

Email , or reach us on WhatsApp through our contact page.

See also our Terms & Advertising Policy.
